literal.prompt: В какое море Северного Ледовитого океана впадает Лена?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NASA Lena L266 directly identifies the Lena delta and annual river discharge into Laptev Sea. The four labels are parallel Arctic marginal seas; only Laptev is this river mouth.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это море Лаптевых. У его побережья Лена образует обширную дельту.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The explanation names Laptev and an extensive Lena delta. NASA L242 calls it the largest Arctic delta and L266 gives width and seaward extent; both sentences are supported.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Карское море принимает сток Оби и Енисея.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NASA Kara L267-L268 explicitly names Ob and Yenisei and their discharge into Kara Sea. This teaches the named distractor, without saying Lena drains there.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Ежегодно Лена приносит в море Лаптевых почти 550 км³ пресной воды и более 20 млн тонн взвешенных наносов.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NASA Lena L266 explicitly states EACH YEAR nearly 550 cubic kilometres freshwater and MORE THAN 20 million METRIC tonnes SUSPENDED sediment into Laptev. The Russian note preserves all qualifiers and units, adding quantified receiving-sea hydrology beyond the mouth key.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Море Бофорта лежит к северу от Аляски и Канады и принимает сток Маккензи.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Canada L125 explicitly places Mackenzie mouth in Beaufort Sea; NOAA AFSC L83 independently identifies its river discharge. The supplemental complete NOAA Arctic page places Beaufort offshore of Canada and Alaska, within northward offshore Arctic margins. These together ground both geographic and river clauses, rather than equating a US-Arctic label alone with an exact coastline description.
